question: Why is right knowledge the sole cause of liberation?
premises: Right knowledge abides in both self and other.
The divisions of self, other, and so on are mere constructions.
Liberation depends on seeing through such constructed divisions.
inference: Because the divisions of self and other are mere constructions, right knowledge that abides in both is the sole cause of liberation.
plain_english: Right knowledge, abiding in both self and other, is the sole cause of liberation, because the divisions of self, other, and so on are nothing more than constructions.
